metadata.question: Does the urban area extent in Jakarta (centered at 6.2°S, 106.8°E) increase between 1989 and 2004?

data.raw_code: The question is: "Does the urban area extent in Jakarta (centered at 6.2°S, 106.8°E) increase between 1989 and 2004?" We need to compare urban area extent for two years: 1989 and 2004. We'll use Landsat 5 Surface Reflectance (SR) data since it covers both years. Approach: 1. Define geometry: A point at (-6.2, 106.8) with a 50km buffer to cover the urban area. 2. For each year, get Landsat 5 SR images for the entire year (Jan 1 to Dec 31). 3. Apply cloud and water masking using the pixel_qa band. 4. Create a median composite for each year. 5. Compute NDBI (Normalized Difference Built-up Index) = (SWIR - NIR) / (SWIR + NIR) using band 5 (SWIR) and band 4 (NIR). 6. Threshold NDBI > 0.1 to create an urban mask. 7. Compute urban area by counting urban pixels and multiplying by pixel area (30m × 30m = 900 m² = 0.0009 km²). 8. Compare the areas. If urban area in 2004 > urban area in 1989, answer "A: Yes", else "B: No". We need to handle: - No images (C1): Check collection size. If 0, try Landsat 4 for 1989? Actually, Landsat 5 covers both years, but if no images, we might need to widen the date range or try another collection. - No valid pixels after masking (C2): Check count of valid pixels (after masking) for each year. - Invalid calculation (C3): Check if area values are null/undefined or unrealistic. We'll output concise stats: number of images for each year, urban area in km², and pixel counts. We'll use a scale of 1000 for reduceRegion to avoid memory issues, but for area calculation, we need to use 30m to count pixels accurately. We can use scale=30 with maxPixels=1e9. We'll structure the code accordingly. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point(106.8, -6.2); const geometry = point.buffer(50000); // 50km buffer const years = [1989, 2004]; const startDate1 = '1989-01-01'; const endDate1 = '1989-12-31'; const startDate2 = '2004-01-01'; const endDate2 = '2004-12-31'; // Function to mask clouds and water in Landsat 5 SR function maskCloudsAndWater(image) { const qa = image.select('pixel_qa'); const clear = qa.bitwiseAnd(2).neq(0); // bit 1: clear const cloudShadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(8).neq(0); // bit 3: cloud shadow const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(32).neq(0); // bit 5: cloud const water = qa.bitwiseAnd(4).neq(0); // bit 2: water const mask = clear.and(cloudShadow.eq(0)).and(cloud.eq(0)).and(water.eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Function to compute NDBI and urban area for a given year async function getUrbanArea(startDate, endDate, yearLabel) { let collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C01/T1_SR') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(geometry); let size = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${yearLabel} Images: ${size}`); // If no images, try Landsat 4 for 1989 (only for 1989, as 2004 has Landsat 5/7) if (size === 0 && yearLabel === '1989') { collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT04/C01/T1_SR') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(geometry); size = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${yearLabel} Landsat 4 Images: ${size}`); } if (size === 0) { return { area: null, validPixels: 0, count: size, label: yearLabel }; } // Process images const composite = collection .map(maskCloudsAndWater) .median() .clip(geometry); // Compute NDBI: (B5 - B4) / (B5 + B4) const ndbi = composite.normalizedDifference(['B5', 'B4']).rename('ndbi'); // Urban mask: NDBI > 0.1 const urbanMask = ndbi.gt(0.1).rename('urban'); // Count urban pixels at 30m resolution const urbanCount = urbanMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('urban'); const countValue = await urbanCount.getInfo(); const areaKm2 = countValue * 0.0009; // 30m pixel area = 900 m2 = 0.0009 km2 // Also count total valid pixels (after masking) for checking C2 const validMask = composite.select('B3').mask(); // using band 3 as proxy for valid data const validCount = validMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, // coarser scale for quick check maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B3'); const validValue = await validCount.getInfo(); return { area: areaKm2, validPixels: validValue, count: size, label: yearLabel }; } // 2. Data Acquisition & Processing const area1989 = await getUrbanArea(startDate1, endDate1, '1989'); const area2004 = await getUrbanArea(startDate2, endDate2, '2004'); // 3. Check for data issues // C1: Empty collection if (area1989.count === 0 || area2004.count === 0) { console.log(`C1`); return; } // C2: No valid pixels after masking if (area1989.validPixels === 0 || area2004.validPixels === 0) { console.log(`C2`); return; } // 4. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`1989 Urban Area: ${area1989.area.toFixed(2)} km², Valid Pixels: ${area1989.validPixels}`); console.log(`2004 Urban Area: ${area2004.area.toFixed(2)} km², Valid Pixels: ${area2004.validPixels}`); // C3: Calculation failure (null/NaN/unrealistic values) if (area1989.area === null || area2004.area === null || isNaN(area1989.area) || isNaN(area2004.area) || area1989.area < 0 || area2004.area < 0 || area1989.area > 10000 || area2004.area > 10000) { // Jakarta area < 10,000 km² console.log(`C3`); return; } // Compare areas if (area2004.area > area1989.area) { console.log(`A`); } else { console.log(`B`); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
